verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Vast.ai serves an llms.txt at docs.vast.ai/llms.txt that indexes its documentation as markdown (.md) pages. There is also a dedicated agents guide for the `vastai` agent skill and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), independent or hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these docs.
